```{r}
# install.packages("ggplot2")
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

# Read in the data and store as "ci_np" data object
ci_np <- read.csv("ci_np.csv")

# display the first 6 rows
head(ci_np)

#look at column names
colnames(ci_np)
```

Graphing Time YAY

```{r}
ggplot(data = ci_np)

#try again w/ mapping
ggplot(data = ci_np, mapping = aes(x = year, y = visitors)) 

#Scatterplot
ggplot(data = ci_np, mapping = aes(x = year, y = visitors)) +
  geom_point()

#Column graph
ggplot(data = ci_np, mapping = aes(x = year, y = visitors)) +
  geom_col()

#Line plot
ggplot(data = ci_np, mapping = aes(x = year, y = visitors)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()

#Smooth line
ggplot(data = ci_np, mapping = aes(x = year, y = visitors)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth()

#Linear model
#Smooth line
ggplot(data = ci_np, mapping = aes(x = year, y = visitors)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```
